paragraphs: From Waterford Six Cross Roads Business Park, depart the parking area and continue along the internal estate road
At the end of the road turn right, then at the roundabout take the 1st exit slight left onto the Six Cross Roads Business Park roundabout exit road
Continue slight left onto the L5021 at the next roundabout on Cumann na mBan Ring Road
Take the 1st exit slight left and stay straight through the following roundabout, continuing along the ring road for just over a kilometre
Keep straight through the next roundabout as well, staying on Cumann na mBan Ring Road
Continue onto Cork Road through the roundabout, going straight ahead
After about 1.5 km turn left onto Paddy Brown's Road
At the mini roundabout continue straight take the 1st right into Larchville
Take the next left within the estate, then work your way back out by turning right at the end of the road, and right again onto Paddy Brown's Road
Turn right onto Arbor Road, then at the end of the road turn right onto Vincent White Road
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto Cannon Street
Turn right onto Blakes Lane right again at the end onto Hennessy's Road
Continue along Hennessy's Road turn left onto Ashe Road at the end and left again onto the Inner Ring Road
At Kingsmeadow Roundabout go straight through, taking the exit onto the unnamed link road
Turn slight left onto Yellow House Lane take the next left to stay on Yellow House Lane
At the roundabout take the slight left exit onto Kilbarry Road and follow it straight through the next roundabout, staying on Kilbarry Road
To return toward the Waterford test centre area
Take the slight left exit at the roundabout back into Six Cross Roads Business Park, then keep slight left at the fork
Loop out once more via the L5021 and Cumann na mBan Ring Road if practicing the extended version, taking the slight left exit onto Butlerstown Road
Left onto Ballybeg Drive, left onto Cork Road, and right onto the unnamed road to finish back near the Waterford Six Cross Roads test centre
